# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server: what a weapon pickup does to a player and to the items.
# map mp_carentan, gametype probe_pickup, joined allies, weapon m1carbine_mp
# Two shells, the gsc probe first:
#   COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> SECS=150 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_pickup mp_carentan +set probe_teleport 1 +set scr_allow_fg42 1
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:28970 --save-pickup --probe-secs 120
# scr_allow_fg42 1 is not stock: default_mp.cfg sets it 0, and _teams::restrictPlacedWeapons
# then deletes both fg42s at map load. A run without it has no fg42 to take (added to this
# header by hand; the writer in probe.rs does not print it).
# The gsc probe puts the player on the first fg42 at spawn and on the second two
# seconds after the first is taken; every jump in origin here is one of those.
# Phases: stand 1000 ms; aim 1000 ms; use1 taps use 300 ms in; touch2 holds 2000 ms past
# the second teleport; switch asks for the carbine; use2 taps on the nearest panzerfaust;
# early and late tap on the dropped carbine 500 and 1500 ms after use2's tap.
# !cmd view= is the absolute view asked for (wire shorts, before delta_angles); angles= went on the wire.
# !trace clip and ammo are the non-zero entries as index:value; hint is serverCursorHint:Val:String.
# !item is every eType 3 entity within 256 units; pos and apos are type,time,base xyz,delta xyz.
# !server is every server command, tokens joined, control bytes as \xNN.
[phase wait]
!server ms=0 f MPSCRIPT_CONNECTED\x15vcod^7
!server ms=0 v g_scriptMainMenu team_americangerman
!server ms=0 v scr_showweapontab 0
!server ms=0 t 0
!server ms=0 v cg_objectiveText DM_KILL_OTHER_PLAYERS\x15
!server ms=0 v scr_showweapontab 1
!server ms=0 v g_scriptMainMenu weapon_american
!server ms=0 t 1
!server ms=0 v cg_objectiveText DM_KILL_OTHER_PLAYERS\x15
